hero.title: Spend the session with the child,
hero.subtitle: DoctorNearMe is the autism and early intervention platform. Its Child Development module, powered by the CareThread engine, talks to the parent before the first session, documents the online session and fills the assessment form, and hands the complete case to the specialist.

reel.intakeCaption: DoctorNearMe talks with the parent, in their own language.
reel.intakeCardQuote: He said a few words at two, then he stopped.
reel.sessionCaption: You stay with the child. DoctorNearMe documents.
reel.sessionNote1: Looks away when his name is called
reel.sessionNote2: Lines up toy cars, repeats the order
reel.sessionNote3: Covers his ears at the noise
reel.reviewCaption: Every ISAA rating is linked to the moment it was said. You confirm it.
reel.reviewCardQuote: he does not look at us when we talk
reel.handoffCaption: The specialist receives the complete case, ready to act on.

problem.title: The signs appear at 2.
problem.stat1Label: Parents notice the first signs (23 months on average)
problem.stat2Label: The window: the younger support starts, the bigger the gains
problem.stat3Label: Median age at which US children are identified; only half are evaluated by age 3
problem.stat4Label: Average age at which German children are identified: after Kita, at school entry
problem.prevalence1Label: US children have autism (1 in 20 boys)
problem.whyLateText: Too few specialists, year-long waitlists, and therapists who spend their sessions on paperwork.
problem.sources: Sources: CDC ADDM 2025 · WHO · Höfer et al. 2019

voice.title: Hear how DoctorNearMe
voice.intro: Before the first visit, the family talks to the DoctorNearMe intake assistant, built on ElevenLabs, in their own language. The therapist walks into session 1 already knowing the history, so the session goes to the child.
voice.step1Title: A link, not a waiting room
voice.step1Text: After booking, the parent gets a private link by WhatsApp or email and opens it on their phone.
voice.step2Text: The assistant says it is an AI, that the call is recorded for the therapist, and asks before it continues.
voice.step3Text: Telugu, Hindi or English, one question at a time: speech, lost words, eye contact, play, sounds, routines, safety.
voice.step4Text: Red flags such as lost speech or self-injury are quoted in the parent's words. It documents; the therapist decides.
voice.afterText: The recording, every answer in the parent's own words, red flags you can replay, and the questions to check in session 1. The therapist confirms each answer.

solution.title: One thread, from the first call
solution.evidence1Label: toddlers identified with autism at 1 to 3 years no longer met the criteria at age 5 to 7
solution.evidence2Label: IQ points after 2 years of early intervention vs usual care (randomised trial)
solution.sources: Sources: Harstad et al., JAMA Pediatrics 2023 · Dawson et al., Pediatrics 2010

how.intakeTitle: DoctorNearMe talks to the parent before the first session
how.intakeText: Send the parent a link. DoctorNearMe holds a calm, guided conversation in their language, right in the browser. You open the case to a pre-session brief instead of a blank page.
how.intakePoint1: No app to install for parents
how.intakePoint3: English, Hindi and Telugu today, German coming soon
how.briefConcern: few words, does not answer to his name
how.sessionTitle: Run the session. DoctorNearMe fills the ISAA form
how.sessionText: Upload or record the online session. DoctorNearMe transcribes it and suggests a rating for each of the 40 ISAA items, each linked to the exact quote and timestamp. Nothing counts until you confirm it.
how.sessionPoint1: Evidence quote and timestamp on every item
how.sessionPoint2: Confirm or edit each rating in one click
how.quoteLostSpeech: said a few words at two, then stopped
how.quoteSensory: covers his ears at the mixer
how.handoffTitle: Hand the complete case to the specialist
how.handoffText: Mark the report final and DoctorNearMe builds the referral packet: intake, confirmed ISAA with evidence, and the parent's voice note. The specialist opens it by link and can ask the case questions.
how.handoffPoint1: Report drafted from confirmed items only
how.handoffPoint2: One link for the specialist, no account
how.handoffPoint3: Ask the case: answers cite their source

who.title: Built for therapists.
who.intro: Therapists log in and do the work. Centres subscribe. Families and specialists join free, by link.
who.therapistPain: Fills a 40-item form while watching the child. Writes reports after hours.
who.therapistGain: Arrives with a brief. The form fills itself, she confirms every item.
who.centrePain: Therapist burnout and churn. Records differ from centre to centre.
who.centreGain: More assessments per therapist and one standard, evidence-backed record with an audit log.
who.familyPain: Months on a waitlist. Explaining everything in a second language.
who.familyGain: An intake call in Telugu, Hindi or English and a voice summary in their language.
who.specialistPain: Thin referral letters. Takes the full history again.
who.specialistGain: A referral packet with evidence, and answers from the case with timestamps.

features.title: Documentation you can
features.evidenceTitle: Every rating comes with its evidence
features.evidenceText: Each suggested ISAA rating links to the parent's own words and the second it was said. Click to hear it.
features.quoteEyeContact: he does not look at us when we talk
features.quoteLostSpeech: said a few words at two, then stopped
features.quoteFlapping: he flaps his hands when he is excited
features.chargeText: Confirm, edit or reject each item. The score only counts what you confirmed.
features.briefText: What the parent shared, the main concerns, and what to watch for.
features.askText: Ask a question in plain words. The answer cites the intake or the session.
features.askAnswer: Around age two, after a few first words.
features.voiceText: Parents can add a voice note in their language. It travels with the case.

trust.title: AI documents,
trust.intro: DoctorNearMe does the writing. Every rating, every line of the report and every referral is checked and signed off by a person.
trust.consentText: Parents agree before any call or recording starts.
trust.evidenceText: Each suggestion links to the exact moment in the session.
trust.clinicianText: Nothing reaches the report until the therapist confirms or edits it.
trust.privateText: Private storage and an audit log of every change and decision.

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.intro: Something else on your mind? Ask us on the demo call.
faq.a1: Early intervention therapists and child psychologists use it every day. Centres subscribe for their team. Parents and specialists never need an account: they get a link from the therapist.
faq.a2: Always the clinician. DoctorNearMe is not a diagnosis. It documents what was said and suggests ratings with evidence. The clinician reviews, edits and decides every item.
faq.q3: What happens in the AI intake call?
faq.a3: Before session 1 the parent opens a private link and talks to the DoctorNearMe assistant in Telugu, Hindi or English. It asks for consent first, then one question at a time. The therapist receives the recording and a pre-session brief with the parent's own words.
faq.a4: The ISAA (Indian Scale for Assessment of Autism), all 40 items, with an evidence quote and timestamp for each suggestion.
faq.a5: English, Hindi and Telugu today. German is coming soon. Reports are written in English.
faq.a6: Book a demo. We walk you through DoctorNearMe on a sample case, then set up your centre's workspace and send your team their logins.
